guide_enrichment.narrative: Our slight lean toward Wake Forest comes from an offense that has shown multiple ways to move the ball. Gio Lopez has thrown for 575 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions through two games, while adding 98 rushing yards and two scores. Carlos Hernandez has supplied 253 receiving yards, and Wake Forest has scored on nine of its first 10 red-zone possessions. That production is encouraging, but we are not treating a two-game sample as proof that it will carry over unchanged.
guide_enrichment.matchup_to_watch: For us, the matchup to watch is Lopez and the Wake Forest passing game against Louisville’s pass defense. Lopez’s ability to contribute through the air and on the ground gives Wake Forest a path to sustain offense, but our efficiency numbers rate Louisville’s pass defense well ahead of Wake Forest’s passing attack. That tension explains both our modest preference for the underdog and why it remains a pass: the football case is plausible, but the available price does not create meaningful separation from the market.

recent_game.fact: Wake Forest defeated Purdue 38-36 in double overtime on Sept. 12, 2026, improving to 2-0.
On fourth-and-15 in the second overtime against Purdue, Gio Lopez completed a 15-yard pass to Carlos Hernandez; Lopez then scored the tying touchdown and the game-winning two-point conversion.
Against Purdue, Lopez completed 16 of 27 passes for 225 yards and one touchdown and led Wake Forest with 59 rushing yards and two rushing touchdowns.
Carlos Hernandez caught six passes for 88 yards against Purdue.
Wake Forest committed no turnovers against Purdue.
Purdue produced a 114-yard rusher, a 329-yard passer and three rushing touchdowns against Wake Forest.

quarterback.fact: Gio Lopez has started both 2026 games and has completed 37 of 59 passes for 575 yards, four touchdowns and no interceptions.
Lopez has rushed 20 times for 98 yards and two touchdowns through two games.
Lopez transferred to Wake Forest from North Carolina and previously played at South Alabama under current Wake Forest offensive coordinator Rob Ezell.
Wake Forest's unofficial projected depth chart lists Lopez as the starting quarterback and redshirt freshman Steele Pizzella as the backup.
